newsitem.title: USA: Watsco to buy Inter-City branches.
newsitem.headline: Watsco to buy Inter-City branches.

text.p: Wasco Inc and Inter-City Products Corp (USA) said Friday that they have signed a definitive agreement for Watsco's purchase of Inter-City's subsidiary, Coastline Distribution Inc. and four other distribution branches owned by Inter-City.
The price, which will be in cash, was not disclosed. Revenue for these businesses are estimated to be $93 million in 1996.

Coastline is an Orlando, Florida-based wholesale distributor of residential central air conditioners and related parts and supplies. It sells the Tempstar, Heil and AirQuest brands of heating and cooling products, manufactured by Inter-City Products, through 21 branches across Florida, Georgia and Alabama. The other four branches being acquired sell Inter-City Products' Comfortmaker brand products from outlets located in Atlanta, Georgia; Charlotte, North Carolina; Los Angeles, California; and Savage, Maryland.
